title: Drag as command - writes through contracts with visible refusal
description: WHY: Trello columns lie - anyone can drag a card to Done. This board refuses: statuses are derived, so drag must be a command whose failure is rendered, which is the UI expression of the entire evidence-gated thesis. WHAT: (1) map drag interactions to command invocations against the owning project workspace - drag to In Progress issues work reserve, drag to Closed issues work close with a reason prompt, drag back to ready issues work release; the console server executes through the same CLI JSON contracts it already uses, workspace-qualified; (2) on command failure the card snaps back and the enforcement gaps from the error render in a refusal panel naming the unsatisfied gates or blockers and the exact commands that would clear them (the gaps carry nextCommand data via the directive registry); (3) optimistic UI is forbidden - the card moves only after the command succeeds and the rollup refreshes, and the interim state shows in-flight; (4) transitions that are not representable as commands (dragging into blocked or verified, which are derived-only) are not droppable targets at all.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful reserve and close drags move cards only after command success, covered by console integration tests
A close drag against unsatisfied gates snaps back and renders the gate gaps with their clearing commands
closedReason: Drag-as-command board behavior implemented, focused console coverage passed, and pnpm check passed.
